# Spotify

6 endpoints, all GET. Base URL `https://www.socialcrawl.dev`, auth header `x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY`.

**Credit costs:** 6 standard (1 credit) - the exact cost is in each endpoint heading below.

<!-- BEGIN:GENERATED:ENDPOINTS (auto-generated by generate-docs.ts - AIP-16b) -->

## GET /v1/spotify/album - 1 credit (standard)

Get a Spotify album

**Cost** 1 credit (standard) · **Cache** 600s (a hit costs 0 credits) · **Returns** Post · **Pagination** none

Returns album metadata — artists, release date, cover art, copyright info, tracks, and sharing details. Pass either `id` or `url`.

**Query params**

- `id` (optional, string) - Spotify album ID.
- `url` (optional, string) - Spotify album URL. · e.g. `https://open.spotify.com/album/0pgrg7phBbnwGJ2HBEl9EG`

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `id`, `url`.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/spotify/album?url=https://open.spotify.com/album/0pgrg7phBbnwGJ2HBEl9EG" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/spotify/artist - 1 credit (standard)

Get a Spotify artist

**Cost** 1 credit (standard) · **Cache** 900s (a hit costs 0 credits) · **Returns** Author · **Pagination** none

Returns artist metadata — id, name, followers, genres, and related artists. Pass either `id` or `url`.

**Query params**

- `id` (optional, string) - Spotify artist ID.
- `url` (optional, string) - Spotify artist URL. · e.g. `https://open.spotify.com/artist/0cGUm45nv7Z6M6qdXYQGTX`

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `id`, `url`.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/spotify/artist?url=https://open.spotify.com/artist/0cGUm45nv7Z6M6qdXYQGTX" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/spotify/podcast - 1 credit (standard)

Get a Spotify podcast

**Cost** 1 credit (standard) · **Cache** 900s (a hit costs 0 credits) · **Returns** Author · **Pagination** none

Returns podcast metadata. Spotify calls podcasts `shows` internally, so Spotify podcast URLs use `/show/`. Pass either `id` or `url`.

**Query params**

- `id` (optional, string) - Spotify podcast (show) ID.
- `url` (optional, string) - Spotify podcast (show) URL. · e.g. `https://open.spotify.com/show/3mliji9352UAk3XnWElnDV`

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `id`, `url`.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/spotify/podcast?url=https://open.spotify.com/show/3mliji9352UAk3XnWElnDV" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/spotify/podcast/episodes - 1 credit (standard)

List a Spotify podcast's episodes

**Cost** 1 credit (standard) · **Cache** 600s (a hit costs 0 credits) · **Returns** PostList · **Pagination** cursor - `cursor`

Returns episodes for a Spotify podcast. Pass the `cursor` from the previous response to fetch the next page.

**Query params**

- `id` (optional, string) - Spotify podcast (show) ID.
- `url` (optional, string) - Spotify podcast (show) URL. · e.g. `https://open.spotify.com/show/4rOoJ6Egrf8K2IrywzwOMk`
- `cursor` (optional, integer) - Cursor returned by the previous response. Omit for page 1.

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `id`, `url`.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/spotify/podcast/episodes?url=https://open.spotify.com/show/4rOoJ6Egrf8K2IrywzwOMk" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/spotify/search - 1 credit (standard)

Search Spotify

**Cost** 1 credit (standard) · **Cache** 120s (a hit costs 0 credits) · **Returns** SearchResult · **Pagination** single page - Fixed-window feed: upstream returns a single non-cursored result set.

Searches Spotify playlists matching a query. Note (DR-MS-09): the upstream currently returns Playlist results only, not the full track/artist/album/episode/podcast/audiobook mix — treat non-playlist result types as unavailable until this is expanded.

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - Search query. · e.g. `my first million`

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/spotify/search?query=my first million" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/spotify/track - 1 credit (standard)

Get a Spotify track

**Cost** 1 credit (standard) · **Cache** 600s (a hit costs 0 credits) · **Returns** Post · **Pagination** none

Returns track metadata — artists, album info, duration, playability, and sharing details. Pass either `id` or `url`.

**Query params**

- `id` (optional, string) - Spotify track ID.
- `url` (optional, string) - Spotify track URL. · e.g. `https://open.spotify.com/track/1ITJflybJsfarsUtiBvkfK`

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `id`, `url`.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/spotify/track?url=https://open.spotify.com/track/1ITJflybJsfarsUtiBvkfK" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
